history.title: A young group in Costa Rica's Central Pacific region
history.lead: Grupo 35 Esparzol was founded on November 9, 2020, as part of a plan by the national office of the Asociación de Guías y Scouts de Costa Rica to open groups in the Central Pacific region.
history.story: It was founded by Elena Manzanarez Juárez, who had previously participated in Grupo 44 de San Francisco de Dos Ríos and brought that experience to Esparza.
history.sponsor: The group is part of the Asociación de Guías y Scouts de Costa Rica, which supports its program and accredits its adult volunteers.

purpose.title: Mission, vision, and values
purpose.missionText: To contribute to the education of children and young people so they can reach their full potential and participate as active citizens in building a better world.
purpose.missionSource: Mission of the Scout Movement, adopted by the Asociación de Guías y Scouts de Costa Rica.
purpose.visionText: To implement good practices and preserve intangible cultural heritage through the Scout method.

designSystem.metaDescription: Colors, typography, components, and rhythm for the Grupo 35 Esparzol website so future pages remain visually consistent.
designSystem.title: Website design system
designSystem.lead: Everything needed to make the Impact, Projects, and Notices pages feel like part of the same site. Values are stored as custom properties in app/globals.css.
designSystem.typographyBodyDetail:
Paragraph 16-20px · Label 13px 800 uppercase

Line height 1.55-1.7 · secondary text #5B5169
designSystem.rhythmDetail:
Maximum width 1280px

Side margins clamp(20px, 5vw, 32px)

Space between sections clamp(56px, 8vw, 84px)

Column gap clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px)

Image radius 24px
designSystem.howToTitle: How to build a new page
designSystem.structureDetail: Create {route}, export generateMetadata, and wrap each block in {section} with a {wrapper} inside. The {layout} already provides the header and footer.
designSystem.accentDetail: Adding data-seccion="manada|tropa|wak|comunidad" to any container changes --acento, --acento-suave, and --acento-texto for everything inside it. Do not write standalone hex values in components.
designSystem.i18nDetail: No visible text is written in JSX: everything comes from messages/<locale>.json through message keys. Server pages use getTranslations, and client components use useTranslations. Available languages are configured in i18n/routing.ts.
designSystem.contentDetail: The site does not publish invented information. Dates, quantities, addresses, contact details, and names use PendingValue or PendingNote until the group confirms them. The full list is available in docs/contenido-pendiente.md.

content.promise: Prometo por mi honor hacer cuanto de mí dependa por cumplir mis deberes para con Dios y mi Patria, ayudar al prójimo en toda circunstancia y cumplir fielmente la Ley Scout.
scoutLaw: Es útil y ayuda a los demás
Es amiga de todos y hermana de toda persona guía o scout
Ve en la naturaleza la obra de Dios
Obedece sin réplica y no deja nada a medias
Sonríe y canta ante las dificultades
Es económica y respeta el bien ajeno

manada.name: Manada
manada.summary: Members learn through play, small groups, and plenty of time outdoors.
manada.description: Manada is the entry point to the Movement. Its symbolic framework comes from The Jungle Book, and the entire program revolves around play: members work in small groups, and each person progresses with support from the leadership team.
manada.imageAlt: Children taking part in an outdoor activity

tropa.name: Tropa
tropa.summary: Members work in patrols through camping and Scout skills.
tropa.description: This is the section that gave rise to the Movement. Tropa is divided into small, autonomous patrols where each person takes on a real role. Members learn outdoor life, Scout skills, and teamwork by doing them.

wak.name: Wak
wak.summary: Young people propose, plan, and carry out their own projects.
wak.description: At this stage, young people take the lead: they propose their own initiatives, plan them, carry them out, and evaluate them. The adult volunteer provides support rather than direction.

comunidad.name: Comunidad
comunidad.summary: Service becomes more than an activity: it becomes a life project.
comunidad.description: The final stage of the journey. Each person defines a personal plan, takes on responsibilities within the group, and sustains long-term service projects.
comunidad.imageAlt: Young people working on a service project
